items.prompt: A price record contains 1.235 under this loader's cent precision policy. What happens?

options.why: The loader rejects excess precision rather than round.

options.text: It is accepted as an approximate float
options.why: The code parses bounded decimal text and does not use a float price.

options.text: Its record is rejected with reason price
options.why: This violates the declared price-text precision rule.

options.text: The entire batch fails and returns no record-level report
options.why: A well-framed record with an invalid price follows the record-reject branch; batch exceptions are reserved for framing, schema or limit failures.

items.explanation: The loader's explicit no-rounding policy differs from the serialization lesson's demonstration of an optional named rounding mode.
